items.originalTitle: Williams, Alpine fall foul of F1's 2025 cost cap
detailZh: 威廉姆斯和阿斯顿·马丁车队违反了2025年一级方程式成本上限
威廉姆斯和阿斯顿·马丁车队在与国际汽联达成接受违规协议后，违反了一级方程式2025年的成本上限
威廉姆斯和阿斯顿·马丁车队违反了一级方程式2025年的成本上限，与国际汽联达成接受违规协议，威廉姆斯因超支而受到体育处罚，阿斯顿·马丁则被处以罚款
国际汽联于周三宣布，威廉姆斯超支了2025年成本上限62.7万英镑或0.48%。超支被发现是通过车队对财务规定的解释方式造成的，这意味着它犯下了所谓的“轻微超支违规和程序违规”
国际汽联的成本上限管理向威廉姆斯车队提供了一个可接受违规协议（ABA），该车队接受了这个协议。管理机构指出，车队"表现出了合作和诚信"，并得出结论，威廉姆斯车队没有试图寻求体育优势。
尽管如此，国际汽联对威廉姆斯车队既实施了财务处罚，也实施了体育处罚。除了支付给国际汽联一笔未公开的罚款并偿还成本上限管理费用外，威廉姆斯车队将在接下来的12个月内被扣除1.5%的风洞和CFD测试费用。
车队在一项声明中解释说，在重组其团队结构时犯了一个错误，认为其中一些行政成本超出了成本上限。
"违规行为与我们因对公司结构进行更改而产生的行政成本有关。我们相信这些成本超出了上限，"威廉姆斯车队发言人表示。"在与国际汽联的讨论之后，我们已同意按照他们的解释解决此事，即这些成本本应在成本上限内。"
国际汽联指出，威廉姆斯车队并未获得任何体育或财务优势，我们从未寻求过这样的优势。它还指出，在整个审查过程中，我们一直以合作和诚信的态度行事。
诚信是威廉姆斯车队所秉持的核心价值观，我们现在可以关闭这一案件，并专注于我们的未来。我们一直并且将继续是成本上限的坚定支持者，这自然需要准确的执法才能有效。
阿尔派因因程序违规被罚款
与此同时，阿尔派因车队因程序违规被罚款，这意味着它并没有实际超出2025年的上限，但在其财务报告中包含了不准确的信息。
阿尔卑斯车队错误地排除了一些非体育成本，包括市场营销和人力资源费用。
因此，阿尔卑斯车队在偿还成本上限管理费用时也将被罚款。与威廉姆斯车队的情况一样，阿尔卑斯车队的罚款金额并未公开，尽管类似的违规行为通常会被处以30万至50万美元的罚款。
“BWT阿尔卑斯一级方程式车队承认并接受成本上限管理（CCA）对2025年报告期的调查结果，”车队声明称。“车队承认，由于全年报告文件中有关排除和调整的成本不准确，车队无意中犯了一个程序性违规。”
“报告中出现的错误和不准确之处特别与那些CCA认为不会给车队带来任何性能优势的非体育和运营成本有关，例如市场营销活动、非F1活动、人力资源活动、员工奖金成本、成本抵消和库存成本。”
“车队还希望向CCA和FIA表示感谢，在整个过程中他们的勤奋和理解。财务规则仍然相对较新，不断演变且复杂，一些排除和调整对每个车队来说都有待解释。车队承认在整个业务中需要做出集体努力，并认识到未来可以改进的地方。”
detailEn: Williams, Alpine fall foul of F1's 2025 cost cap
Both Williams and Alpine have reached an Accepted Breach Agreement with the FIA after breaching Formula 1's 2025 cost cap

The Williams and Alpine F1 teams have fallen foul of Formula 1's 2025 cost cap, reaching an Accepted Breach Agreement with the FIA, with Williams incurring a sporting penalty for overspending and Alpine handed a fine.

The FIA announced on Wednesday that Williams overspent the 2025 cost cap by £627,000 or 0.48%. The overspend was found to be unintentional through the way the team interpreted the financial regulations, which meant it had committed what is called a "Minor Overspend Breach and a Procedural Breach".

The FIA's cost cap administration offered Williams an Accepted Breach Agreement (ABA), which the team accepted. The governing body noted the team "acted cooperatively and in good faith" and concluded that Williams did not attempt to seek a sporting advantage.

Nevertheless, the FIA handed Williams both a financial and sporting penalty. Alongside paying the FIA an undisclosed fine and reimbursing the cost cap administration expenses, Williams will be docked 1.5% in wind tunnel and CFD testing over the next 12 months.
In a statement the team explained it had made an error while reorganising its team structure, believing some of its administrative costs fell outside the cost cap.

"The breach relates to administrative costs we incurred making changes to our company structure. We believed these costs fell outside of the cap," a Williams spokesperson said. "Following discussions with the FIA, we have agreed to resolve the matter in line with their interpretation that the costs should have been in cap.

"The FIA has noted that Williams did not gain any sporting or financial advantage, and nor did we ever seek to. It has also noted that we acted cooperatively and in good faith throughout the review process.

"Integrity is central to what Williams stands for, and we can now close this case and remain focused on our future. We have always been and will continue to be strong supporters of the Cost Cap, which naturally requires accurate policing to be effective."
Alpine handed fine for procedural breach
Meanwhile, Alpine was fined for a "Procedural Breach", which meant it did not actually overspend the 2025 cap but included inaccuracies in its financial reporting.
Alpine wrongly excluded a number of non-sporting costs, including marketing and HR expenses.

As a result, Alpine will also be handed a fine while reimbursing the cost cap administration expenses. As is the case with Williams, the size of Alpine's fine was not disclosed, although similar offences are usually thought to be fined somewhere between $300,000 and $500,000.

"BWT Alpine Formula One Team acknowledges and accepts the findings of the Cost Cap Administration (CCA) for the 2025 Reporting Period," the team stated. "The team accepts that it unknowingly committed a Procedural Breach, which is a result of inaccuracies in the Full Year Reporting Documentation for costs related to exclusions and adjustments.

"The errors and inaccuracies in the reporting were specifically related to non-sporting and operational costs which the CCA recognised didn’t give the team any performance advantage, such as Marketing Activities, non-F1 Activities, HR Activities, Employee’s Bonus Costs, Offsetting of Costs, and Costs of Inventories.

"The team would also like to express its thanks to both the CCA and FIA, for its diligence and understanding throughout the entire process. The Financial Regulations are still relatively new, constantly evolving and complex, with some exclusions and adjustments being open to each team’s interpretation. The team acknowledges the collective efforts it needs to make across the business and recognises where improvements can be made in future."

detailZh: Zak Brown排除了麦凯轮为F1 2030提供的引擎计划
英国品牌目前是梅赛德斯的车队客户
安东内利, 梅赛德斯, 兰多·诺里斯, 麦凯轮
Zak Brown已经排除了为2030年一级方程式赛车赛季提供工厂引擎计划，因为麦凯轮对与梅赛德斯的合作关系“非常满意”。
英国品牌自2021年以来一直是梅赛德斯客户，并在这一时期取得了巨大成功，赢得了两个车队冠军（2024年、2025年）、一个车手冠军（2025年）和24场大奖赛。
但F1将在2030年迎来下一次引擎变革，通过引入涡轮增压、2.1升V8动力单元来取代今年才出现的现有引擎，但这些引擎已经证明存在争议。
布朗在上周末的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上表示：“这是我们过去考虑过的事情，但我们非常满意HPP。
“我认为我们已经证明我们可以用它们赢得冠军，所以我们没有打算在我们的车后面放任何除了梅赛德斯之外的东西。”
这个问题是由麦凯轮车队在本赛季与梅赛德斯引擎的麻烦引起的，一度导致两家制造商之间的关系紧张。
这发生在工厂和客户车队之间在更复杂的引擎上存在知识差距之后，麦凯轮车队难以充分利用其梅赛德斯动力单元的最大潜力。
因此，英国车队至少探索了成为自己制造商的想法，尤其是在转向更便宜的公式更加可行的时候，但麦凯轮车队在2026年下半年表现强劲，赢得了三场比赛。
我认为，对于整个车手阵容来说，这是一个充满挑战的季节，这些动力单元带来的挑战，”麦凯轮赛车首席执行官补充道，他的车队在积分榜上排名第四，落后冠军梅赛德斯235分。
“所以我们已经和梅赛德斯合作了一段时间。他们是一对极好的合作伙伴。”
“我们在赛道上遇到过一些问题，他们也在赛道上遇到过一些问题。我认为每个车队在赛道上都会遇到问题，但我们有一个很好的工作关系。”
“我们非常有信心我们得到的是相同的规格。这就是规则，你知道，我们在赢得比赛。我们上周末赢了，所以是的，我们很高兴。”
布朗的评论是在Motorsport.com透露F1计划从2030年开始转向每个制造商提供两个动力单元的计划之前——包括工厂车队。
所以，每个引擎将只剩下一个小车队，考虑到迈凯轮、阿尔派和威廉姆斯都是梅赛德斯的车队客户，这可能会在赛道内引起政治上的阴谋诡计。
考虑到法拉利也将有一个客户车队（哈斯），加上红牛（小红牛），这留下了奥迪、本田和通用汽车凯迪拉克的潜在选择。
然而，布朗对2030年的引擎更换感到“非常、非常兴奋”，这一变化是在F1、其制造商和FIA的共同努力下提前一年的。
“我认为现在是要把所有的细节都处理好，”他补充道。“如果你看看FIA所做的事情，他们已经宣布了全职裁判。”
“所以他们非常积极主动，行动迅速，说到做到。我认为这项运动从未如此健康。我认为竞争非常精彩。”
“因此，我对这项运动未来的发展充满信心。现在的状态已经很好了。我对新引擎感到兴奋，我认为每个人都会这样。”
“但我认为还有更多的事情正在进行，以继续推动这项运动的发展。所以，我认为在FIA和一级方程式之间，他们正在做一件了不起的工作。”
detailEn: Zak Brown rules out McLaren engine programme for F1 2030
The British marque is currently a Mercedes customer squad
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Lando Norris, McLaren
Zak Brown has ruled out a factory engine programme for the 2030 Formula 1 campaign as McLaren is “very happy” with its Mercedes partnership.

The British marque has been a Mercedes customer since 2021 and has enjoyed vast success in that period, winning two constructors’ titles (2024, 2025), a drivers’ championship (2025) and 24 grands prix.
But F1 is set for its next engine change in 2030 by introducing turbocharged, 2.1-litre V8 power units to replace the current ones that only came in this year, yet have proven to be contentious.
Brown said at last weekend’s Las Vegas Grand Prix: “It's something we've looked at in the past, but we're very happy with HPP.
“I think we've proven that we can win championships with them, so we don't have any intention to have anything in the back of our car other than a Mercedes.”
The question was prompted by McLaren’s struggles with its Mercedes engine this season that at one point caused the relationship between both manufacturers to come under strain.
It came after there was a knowledge gap on the more complex engine between the factory and customer outfit, with McLaren struggling to exploit the maximum from its Mercedes power unit.

So the British outfit did at least explore the idea of becoming its own manufacturer, especially when a move to a cheaper formula is more feasible, but McLaren has enjoyed a stronger second half of 2026 with three wins.
"It's been a challenging season, I think, for the entire grid with these power units,” added the McLaren Racing CEO, whose squad is fourth in the standings and 235 points behind champions Mercedes.
“So we've been working with Mercedes for quite some time. They've been an awesome partner.
“We've had some issues on track, they've had some issues on track. I think every team has had issues on track, but we've got a great working relationship.
“Very confident we get the same specification. That's what the regulations are, and, you know, we're winning races. We won last weekend, so yeah, we're happy.”
Brown’s comments did, however, come before Motorsport.com revealed F1’s plans to shift towards two power unit supplies per manufacturer come 2030 - including the factory team.
So that would leave just one customer squad per engine and with McLaren, Alpine and Williams all Mercedes customers, it will potentially cause political intrigue throughout the paddock.
Considering Ferrari will also have a customer team for then (Haas), plus Red Bull (Racing Bulls), it leaves potential options of Audi, Honda and Cadillac’s General Motors.
Nevertheless, Brown is “very, very excited” for the engine change in 2030, which has been brought forward by a year following joint efforts from F1, its manufacturers and the FIA.
“I think now it's about kind of dotting the i's and crossing the t's,” he added. “If you look at what the FIA has done, they've announced full-time stewards.
“So, they are very proactive, they move quick, they do what they say they're going to do. I think the sport's never been healthier. I think the competition is amazing.
“So, I've got a lot of confidence in the future of the sport. Where it is today is great. I'm excited for the new engines, I think everyone will be.
“But I think there's a lot more also going on to continue to evolve the sport. So, I think between the FIA and Formula 1, they're doing a great job.”

items.titleZh: F1新引擎冻结规则可能提前回归的罕见原因
items.summaryZh: F1承诺从2030年开始实施新的引擎规则，这可能导致在那时之前回归引擎冻结规则。通用汽车原计划从2029年开始为凯迪拉克制造V6引擎，但由于规则变化，这一计划已被搁置。
items.originalTitle: The unusual reason F1's engine freeze could return
detailZh: 一级方程式赛车从2030年开始承诺其新的引擎规定，这预示着在此之前将恢复引擎冻结规则——但原因非常特殊。
一级方程式赛车之前因成本原因，在2007-13年的大部分V8时代冻结了引擎开发，然后在2022-25年的空气动力学规定期间，在COVID大流行期间的财务压力和全新2026年引擎的到来之间冻结了引擎开发。
这次，对于当前引擎规定的最后一年半可能出现的引擎冻结，实际上是由如果采取行动，新来者将在2030年获得优势的前景所驱动的。
通用汽车计划从2029年开始为凯迪拉克按照当前的V6规则制造自己的引擎。即使今年有关于V8回归的很多讨论，GM也预计将在规则变更的原有预期下使用V6两年。
现在情况并非如此，通用汽车已经搁置了V6项目——它表示已经在单缸上做了一些初步工作。由于V8保持了相同的缸径尺寸，这些工作并没有浪费，尽管一些竞争对手对通用汽车是否真的打算在当前规则变得岌岌可危后建造V6表示怀疑。
无论如何，凯迪拉克将继续成为法拉利的客户，直到2030年的规则变更。
但是，将凯迪拉克发动机的首次亮相推迟到V8规则中，又产生了新的问题。
由于当前制造商不想让凯迪拉克从现在到2030年仅仅将资源全部投入到V8中而获得优势，因此出现了V6发动机开发冻结的前景。
如果当前的引擎一直开发到2029年底，现有的制造商将同时做两件事：改进今天的V6和设计V8。
通用汽车只做一件事，它将在2030年到来，已经把整个预算都花在了那个重要的引擎上。
大多数制造商最终会将大部分，如果不是全部，资源转向2030年，以优先考虑新时代，并为所有车队建造和维护引擎仍然是一项艰巨的任务。
但如果梅赛德斯或红牛或任何其他车队陷入激烈的锦标赛争夺中，他们将有义务继续寻找引擎改进中还能找到的任何收益。
2030年的完整规则可能要到2027年中旬才能完成，因此《赛车》杂志了解到，当前的引擎可能从2028年中旬开始冻结。
那时制造商拥有的任何性能，他们将保持到2029年底。
这有其自身的后果。现在落后的任何制造商实际上有半年的时间来赶上。在那之后，直到V8引擎到来，排名将锁定。
这次冻结将停止ADUO，这是一个旨在帮助陷入困境的制造商的追赶系统，但它可能不会永远消失。
在这个时代，它并没有完全按照预期工作，但帮助任何下次失利的制造商的想法仍然很可能会被写入规则中。
正如我们在之前的引擎冻结时代所经常看到的那样，制造商总是热衷于在可靠性修改或其他冻结规则允许的任何范围内推动每一个可能的边界。所以，即使有冻结，也不要期待2028年和2029年的引擎性能会完全静止。
与此同时，任何在引擎上遇到困难的人——现在特别指本田——突然需要在还可能尝试追赶竞争者的时候，和时间展开一场更加紧张的比赛。
detailEn: Formula 1 committing to its new engine regulations from as soon as 2030 is set to mean the return of engine freeze rules before then - but for an unusual reason.

F1 previously froze engine development for cost reasons for the majority of its last V8 era over 2007-13 and then for the duration of the 2022-25 aero regulations between the financial strains of the COVID pandemic and the arrival of the all-new 2026 engines.

This time, the prospect of a new engine freeze for probably the last year and a half of the current engine regulations is actually driven by the prospect of a newcomer having an advantage for 2030 if action isn't taken.

General Motors had planned to build its own engine for Cadillac, to the current V6 rules, from 2029. Even with so much talk this year about the prospect of V8s returning, GM would have expected to get two years' use out of a V6 under the original expectation of when the rules would change.

That's now not the case, and GM has shelved the V6 - on which it says it had done some initial single-cylinder work. Since the V8 keeps the same cylinder dimensions, that work isn't wasted, though some rivals are sceptical about whether GM ever really intended to build a V6 once it was clear the current rules' days were numbered.
Regardless, Cadillac will remain a Ferrari customer until the 2030 rule change now.
But delaying the Cadillac engine debut until the V8 rules creates a new problem.
The prospect of a V6 engine development freeze has arisen because current manufacturers don't want Cadillac to have an advantage from just throwing its resources fully at the V8 from now until 2030.
If the current engines kept developing right up to the end of 2029, the existing manufacturers would be doing two jobs at once: improving today's V6 and designing the V8.
GM would only be doing one, and it would arrive in 2030 having spent its whole budget on the engine that matters.

Most manufacturers would be switching most, if not all, of their resources onto 2030 eventually to prioritise the new era, and building and maintaining engines for all their teams is still a big task.
But if Mercedes or Red Bull or whoever were locked in a tight championship fight, they would be competitively obliged to keep seeking whatever gains could still be found in engine improvements.
The full 2030 rules probably won't be finished before mid-2027, so The Race understands the current engines could be frozen from mid-2028.
Then whatever performance the manufacturers have by then, they keep until the end of 2029.
That has consequences of its own. Any manufacturer that's behind now has, in effect, a season and a half to catch up. After that, the order is locked in until the V8s arrive.
That freeze will halt ADUO, the catch-up system that's meant to help struggling manufacturers, but it probably won't be gone for good.
It hasn't quite worked as intended in this era, but the idea of helping any manufacturer that drops the ball next time is still likely to be enshrined in the regulations.

And as we saw so often in the previous engine freeze eras, manufacturers are always keen to push every boundary possible in what development they can get away with under the guise of reliability modifications or whatever other leeway the freeze rules allow. So don't expect engine performance to be completely static over 2028 and 2029 even with a freeze.

And in the meantime, anyone struggling with their engine - which right now means Honda in particular - is suddenly in a much tighter race against time to get on terms with the competition while it's still possible to try to catch up.
keyPointsZh: F1可能提前实施引擎冻结规则。
由于规则变化，通用汽车的V6引擎计划已被搁置。
keyPointsEn: The engine freeze rules could be implemented earlier than expected.
The plan for a V6 engine by General Motors has been shelved due to rule changes.

items.originalTitle: Fernando Alonso: “We can't be competitive with the power unit we have”
detailZh: 费尔南多·阿隆索：“我们无法用我们现有的动力单元进行竞争”
阿隆索指出阿斯顿·马丁的引擎劣势，但坚持认为本田正在努力改善这种情况
费尔南多·阿隆索表示本田在F1对手中“落后很远”，因此尽管表达了对未来的希望，但阿斯顿·马丁“无法与日本引擎竞争”
随着F1转向包含47%电能的动力单元，本田的新动力总成在动力和可靠性方面都存在问题。制造商在荷兰大奖赛上推出的ADUO升级提高了其马力输出，但牺牲了驾驶性，这从一开始就是问题，阿隆索将其描述为“随机的降挡”。
兰斯·斯特罗尔在巴西因ERS问题遭遇本赛季第13次退赛，情况如此糟糕，以至于本田认为在拉斯维加斯的接近双倍完成情况——阿隆索在最后一圈之前退赛——是令人鼓舞的，尽管绿色赛车在比赛结束时只领先瓦尔特里·博塔斯的凯迪拉克。
高速赛道布局并没有帮助，因为本田在动力上仍然明显落后，AMR26比排位赛最快的赛车慢33km/h，而在比赛中直线差距为27km/h。
“在发动机方面，我们落后很远，我们无法用我们现有的动力单元进行竞争，”阿隆索在阿斯顿·马丁网站上承认。
“有些赛道，比如拉斯维加斯，我们在直道上就比一圈慢两秒以上，可靠性也不在需要的位置。没有人对动力单元方面的情况感到满意，但我们知道本田正在努力改善这种情况。”
“看到幕后进行的努力和承诺，这让我对明年充满信心。”
然而，在底盘方面，进步意味着阿隆索在蜿蜒的赞德福特赛道上获得了第九名，在吉隆坡的雨天条件下获得了第八名——在这两种情况下，动力不足的影响并不那么大。
“‘布达佩斯的底盘升级原本应该带来一定的圈速，它确实做到了这一点，’阿隆索说。‘我们在布达佩斯具有竞争力，我们在赞德福特和马来西亚获得了积分。’"
“‘本赛季我们只对底盘进行了一次大的更新，就进入了中游车队，这让我有信心我们知道我们正在走向何方，并且我们有信心这只是时间问题，我们将会拥有一辆非常好的赛车。’"
detailEn: Fernando Alonso: “We can't be competitive with the power unit we have”
Alonso points out Aston Martin’s engine deficit, but insists Honda is striving to improve the situation
Fernando Alonso says Honda is “a very long way behind” its Formula 1 rivals and Aston Martin therefore “can’t be competitive” with the Japanese engine, albeit expressing hope for the future.

As F1 switched to power units featuring 47% electrical energy, Honda’s new powertrain has been lacking both power and reliability. The ADUO upgrade introduced by the manufacturer at the Dutch Grand Prix improved its horsepower output at the expense of driveability, which had been a problem from the start with what Alonso described as “random downshifts”.

Lance Stroll suffered his 13th race retirement of the season in Brazil due to an ERS issue, with the situation so dire that Honda saw the near double finish in Las Vegas – Alonso retired before the last lap – as encouraging, despite the green cars only leading Valtteri Bottas’ Cadillac at the end of the race.
The high-speed layout didn’t help as Honda remains noticeably down on power, with the AMR26 33km/h slower than the fastest car in qualifying, while its straightline deficit was 27km/h in the race.
“On the engine side, we are a very long way behind and we can't be competitive with the power unit we have,” Alonso admitted on the Aston Martin website.

“There are some circuits like Las Vegas where we are losing more than two seconds a lap on the straights alone, and the reliability is not where it needs to be. No one is happy with how things are going on the PU side of things, but we know Honda is working hard to improve the situation.
“Seeing the work and commitment going on behind the scenes gives me confidence for next year.”

On the chassis side however, progress meant Alonso managed to finish ninth on the winding Zandvoort track and eighth in Sepang’s wet conditions – two contexts in which the power deficit wasn’t as impactful.

“The Budapest chassis upgrade was supposed to deliver a certain lap time, and it delivered that lap time,” Alonso said. “We were competitive in Budapest and we scored points in Zandvoort and Malaysia.

“We've got into the midfield pack with only one large update to the chassis this season, so that has given me the confidence that we know the direction we're heading in and the belief that it's only a matter of time until we have a very good car.”
keyPointsZh: 本田的新动力单元缺乏动力和可靠性
keyPointsEn: Honda's new powertrain lacks power and reliability

Former Formula 1 world champion Jacques Villeneuve says Max Verstappen's Las Vegas Grand Prix victory showed that Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli and George Russell will not be able to beat the Red Bull driver in next year's championship unless they have a superior car.

Verstappen retained the lead from pole position at the start but was challenged by Russell and then later Antonelli for almost the entire 50-lap race amid near constant changes of position throughout the field, but the Red Bull driver expertly saw off their best efforts before both made late errors to drop down the order.

Russell locked up and hit a barrier as he tried to pass Antonelli for second in the closing stages, before the Italian suffered a loss of power at the start of the final lap after incorrectly lifting off the throttle as he was preparing to mount a final challenge to Verstappen.

"You could see that Lewis had good race craft as well as Lando," Villeneuve added.

detailZh: 兰多·诺里斯预计2030年的F1赛车将超越拉斯维加斯大奖赛的壮观场面
兰多·诺里斯质疑拉斯维加斯的352次超车统计数据，表示在2026年的规则下，"有些超车并不是超车"
对于麦凯轮车迷来说，来自沃金克的新闻，有关车手、赛车、团队策略以及每个周末的赛事的最新消息。
一级方程式拉斯维加斯大奖赛呈现了一项为精彩集锦打造的头条统计数据：50圈比赛中共有352次超车和35次领先变化，打破了锦标赛的史上过弯记录。
然而，亚军兰多·诺里斯并不完全认同这个数字在驾驶舱内意味着什么。在完成比赛，落后于马克斯·维斯塔潘0.639秒后，诺里斯在FIA赛后新闻发布会上表示，他对这个原始计数提出了质疑——他认为电池驱动的速度差异使得周六晚上的许多超车感觉远非真正的赛车动作。
“马克斯解释得很好，”诺里斯说，这与维斯塔潘之前对斯特里普的摇摆式编队策略的否定相呼应，称其为“玩马里奥赛车”。从赛车角度来看，从外面看，我确信这可能是Formula 1历史上最好的比赛之一。你永远不知道会发生什么。有些超车是从无到有的。”
然而，在方向盘后面，感觉远不如有机。诺里斯解释说：“问题是，有时候你接近他人的速度有20、30公里每小时，尤其是对我们来说，有些超车并不是超车——你按下增压，就超过了别人。”
整个周末，迈凯轮车队都深刻感受到了直线上的脆弱性。就在诺里斯在排位赛中称MCL40在直道上“糟糕透顶”——在赛道3上几乎失去了八分之一的速度给基米·安东内利，同时他的地板下还夹着一个塑料袋——英国人在比赛初期就滑出了前十，同时他在思考如何分配他的电能。
保持干净仍然得到了丰厚的回报：乔治·拉塞尔在第48圈和安东内利在第49圈的晚些时候犯错，让迈凯轮车队与奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂里一起获得了二、三名的成绩，这是自5月份迈阿密大奖赛以来的首次双料领奖台。
诺里斯相信2030年可以保持比赛的精彩，而不需要花哨的噱头。
尽管对2026年辅助动力飞驰的纯洁性表示质疑，诺里斯并没有完全否定拉斯维加斯的比赛。他认为，凉爽的沙漠沥青路面可以防止在污浊的空气中轮胎过热，他争辩说，拉斯维加斯的街道赛道仍然会带来无休止的轮对轮战斗，而不需要强迫车手不断管理电池储备。
“但比赛仍然很精彩，”诺里斯说。“你仍然在为位置而战，有很多好事发生，但我确信，如果你没有现在这样的电池，你仍然会有同样多的超车。”
“作为车手，我们会更加享受它，因为我们能够全力加速，不必考虑再生和电池，不必部署和部署所有这些事情，”他补充道。“所以，是的，我想说的是我们本可以做得更好。想象一下2030年——哦，我的天，那将是你们见过的最好的比赛。”
诺里斯在周五内华达州的突破之后对2030年的预测具有实际意义，因为在那里，国际汽联宣布了一致原则上同意一项更轻的2030年规则集，该规则集以更简单的2.1升涡轮增压V8发动机、可持续燃料和减少混合动力复杂性为中心——待下个月在上海举行的世界汽车运动理事会投票后确定。
目前，在赢得圣保罗站之后，连续两次登上领奖台使诺里斯的积分与拉塞尔持平，达到264分——比第三名的刘易斯·汉密尔顿少3分——同时将红牛车队在 constructors’ championship 中对麦克拉伦的优势从17分缩小到9分（440分对431分），进入卡塔尔和阿布扎比。
detailEn: Lando Norris expects 2030 F1 racing to surpass Las Vegas GP spectacle
Lando Norris questions Vegas's 352-overtake stat, saying "some of the overtakes weren't overtakes" under 2026 rules
For McLaren fans. Papaya news from Woking, with the latest on the drivers, the car, team strategy and every race weekend.
Formula 1’s Las Vegas Grand Prix delivered a headline statistic built for highlight reels: 352 overtakes and 35 lead changes across 50 laps, shattering the championship’s all-time passing record.

Yet runner-up Lando Norris was not fully sold on what that figure meant from inside the cockpit. Speaking in the FIA post-race press conference after finishing 0.639 seconds behind Max Verstappen, the McLaren driver pushed back on the raw count - arguing that battery-driven speed deltas made plenty of Saturday night’s passes feel far from genuine racing moves.

"Max explained it well," Norris said, echoing Verstappen’s earlier dismissal of the Strip’s yo-yo drafting as "playing Mario Kart". "From a racing point of view, from the outside, I'm sure it probably was the best race ever in Formula 1. You never know what's going to happen. There were overtakes out of nowhere."

Behind the steering wheel, however, the sensation felt far less organic. "The thing is, sometimes you have a closing speed of 20, 30 kph to people, especially to us, and some of the overtakes weren't overtakes - you press boost, and you go past someone," Norris explained.

McLaren felt that straight-line vulnerability acutely all weekend. Just a day after Norris labelled the MCL40 "horrendous in the straights" - having bled nearly eight-tenths to Kimi Antonelli through Sector 3 in qualifying while carrying a stray plastic bag under his floor - the Briton slid outside the top 10 early on while figuring out where to spend his electrical power.

Staying clean still paid off handsomely: late errors from George Russell on Lap 48 and Antonelli on Lap 49 handed McLaren a two–three finish alongside Oscar Piastri, its first double podium since May’s Miami Grand Prix.
Norris believes 2030 can keep the show without the gimmicks

Even while questioning the purity of 2026’s boost-assisted flybys, Norris stopped short of writing off Las Vegas’s action altogether. With cool desert asphalt keeping tyre overheating in dirty air at bay, he argued the Strip would still generate relentless wheel-to-wheel battles without forcing drivers to constantly manage electrical reserves.

"But the racing was still good," Norris said. "You're still fighting for position and just a lot of good things in there, but I'm sure if you didn't have the battery how it was, you would still have just as many overtakes.

"We would enjoy it even more as drivers because we'd be able to push and go flat out and not have to think about re-gen and battery and not deploying and deploying and all of this stuff," he added. "So yeah, we could have been even better is what I'm trying to say. So imagine in 2030 - oh my God, that's going to be the best race you've ever seen."

Norris’s 2030 forecast carries real weight following Friday’s breakthrough in Nevada, where the FIA announced unanimous agreement in principle on a lighter 2030 ruleset centred on simpler 2.1-litre turbocharged V8s, sustainable fuels, and reduced hybrid complexity - pending next month’s World Motor Sport Council vote in Shanghai.

For now, back-to-back podiums after his Sao Paulo win pull Norris level with Russell on 264 points - three shy of Lewis Hamilton in third - while trimming Red Bull’s constructors’ advantage over McLaren from 17 points to nine (440 to 431) entering Qatar and Abu Dhabi.

items.originalTitle: Unaired Las Vegas radio reveals Red Bull considered giving up Max Verstappen's lead
detailZh: 未播出的拉斯维加斯电台透露，红牛考虑放弃维斯塔潘的领先位置
红牛电台消息显示，汤姆·哈特询问维斯塔潘是否考虑在拉斯维加斯大奖赛最后一圈让基米·安东内利超过他
对于红牛车队的粉丝来说，关注红牛赛车，了解F1新闻、车手更新、技术洞察和比赛分析是至关重要的
在几乎任何其他F1比赛中，提出让领跑者在最后一圈故意放弃第一名的想法听起来都是不可想象的。但在2026年拉斯维加斯大奖赛中，红牛的维修区确实提出了这个想法
车队无线电信息揭示了范斯特appen和赛车工程师汤姆·哈特如何激烈地计算周六晚上35次领先变化惊心动魄的最后一阶段。早在第39圈，范斯特appen就感觉到梅赛德斯已经破解了他的在赛道上的部署模式，并要求维修区制定新的计划。
“你们必须看看最后一圈的计划，因为他们已经想明白了，他们仍然可以[不清楚]这条线，”范斯特appen通过无线电说道。“所以我们需要看看我们最后一圈需要做什么。”
哈特回答说策略小组正在“讨论”中，然后在第46圈回来时给出了直截了当的结论：“在部署方面，我们没有比你现在正在做的策略更好的了。所以最后一圈，你已经使用了最好的策略。”
梅赛德斯的车手安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，范斯特appen，红牛车队
一圈之后，哈特警告说前五名赛车之间的差距只有一秒。然后是第48圈，乔治·拉塞尔在与队友基米·安东内利争夺时锁定了第5弯的护栏——维斯塔潘讽刺地说了句‘干得好，我的天啊’，因为他的对手滑出了赛道。
这使2026年世界冠军安东内利成为维斯塔潘在最后一圈的唯一威胁。在警告了第5弯的碎片并更新了间隔后，哈特在第49圈中途给出了当晚最大胆的战略提示。
“安东内利领先1.2秒，皮亚斯特里领先1.9秒。想想看，你想要在检测时成为领跑车，马克斯。这是最后一圈了，”哈特对他说。
哈特的逻辑集中在拉斯维加斯独特的2026年规则上。由于赛道的唯一超车模式检测点位于第16弯之后，任何在那里落后一秒的赛车在整个最后一圈将获得额外的0.5兆焦耳电力部署——搭配1.9公里长直道的强大尾流。领跑过那条线可能会让维斯塔潘在终点线前变成一个靶子。
然而，维斯塔潘从未需要冒险让安东内利通过——因为梅赛德斯的小伙子正试图用同样的手段反其道而行。
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队
安东内利试图在16号弯的检测线上保持在维斯塔潘后面，并在第49圈时发动梅赛德斯最后的冲刺，他在第14弯接近时松开油门，然后轻轻重新施加动力以保持动力。这个意外的踏板序列打乱了车辆的能量回收软件，导致他出弯时电池耗尽，在直道上损失了近两秒。
在最后一圈开始之前，两辆麦拉伦就冲了过去，将哈特的第50圈简报变成了胜利之旅。'最后一圈，车在后面，诺里斯，' 哈特告诉维斯塔潘。'诺里斯1.2，皮亚斯特里2.4。我们可以使用14号弯的加速退出。'
维斯塔潘在最后一段比赛中以1分36.450秒的干净成绩击败了兰多·诺里斯，领先0.639秒，赢得了他2026年的第四次胜利——以及总成绩的第75次胜利——在车手积分榜上领先刘易斯·汉密尔顿37分，同时在车队积分榜上领先迈凯轮9分，进入卡塔尔站。
detailEn: Unaired Las Vegas radio reveals Red Bull considered giving up Max Verstappen's lead
Red Bull radio reveals Tom Hart asked Max Verstappen to consider letting Kimi Antonelli pass before Vegas's final lap
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.

In almost any other Formula 1 race, suggesting a race leader deliberately surrender first place with one lap left would sound unthinkable. At the 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix, Red Bull’s pitwall genuinely floated the idea to Max Verstappen.

Team radio messages revealed just how intensely Verstappen and race engineer Tom Hart calculated the closing stages of Saturday night’s 35-lead-change thriller. As early as Lap 39, Verstappen sensed Mercedes had deciphered his deployment pattern down the Strip and pressed his pitwall for a fresh plan.

"You guys have to look at the plan for the final lap, because they have figured it out, that they can still [unclear] the line," Verstappen radioed. "So we need to see what we have to do for the final lap only."

Hart replied that the strategy group had it "under discussion", before returning seven laps later on Lap 46 with a blunt verdict: "Deployment-wise, we don’t have anything better than the strategy you are doing at the moment. So final lap, you are already using the best strategy."
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing

One lap later, Hart warned that the top five were stacked within a single second. Then came Lap 48, when George Russell locked up into the Turn 5 barrier while fighting team-mate Kimi Antonelli - drawing a sarcastic "Well done. My god," from Verstappen as his rival skidded off.

That left 2026 world champion Antonelli as Verstappen’s sole remaining threat entering the penultimate tour. After warning of Turn 5 debris and updating the intervals, Hart delivered the boldest tactical prompt of the night midway through Lap 49.
"Antonelli at 1.2, Piastri at 1.9. Just consider whether you want to be the lead car at the detection, Max. This is the penultimate lap," Hart told him.

Hart’s logic centred on Las Vegas’s unique 2026 ruleset. With the circuit’s lone Overtake Mode detection point positioned immediately after the Turn 16 chicane, any driver trailing within one second there gained an extra 0.5 MJ of electrical deployment for the entire final lap - paired with a potent slipstream down the 1.9-kilometre Strip. Leading across that line risked turning Verstappen into a sitting duck before the chequered flag.
Yet Verstappen never had to gamble on letting Antonelli through - because Mercedes’ teenager was trying to pull the exact same bluff in reverse.
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing

Aiming to stay behind Verstappen at the Turn 16 detection line and unleash a Mercedes final-lap battery push, Antonelli lifted off the throttle approaching Turn 14 on Lap 49 and gently reapplied power to maintain momentum. That unexpected pedal sequence disrupted his car’s energy-harvesting software, leaving him exiting the corner with zero battery and costing nearly two seconds down the straight.

Both McLarens surged past before the final lap even began, transforming Hart’s Lap 50 briefing into a victory cruise. "Final lap, car behind, Norris," Hart informed Verstappen. "Norris 1.2, Piastri 2.4. And we can use boost exit Turn 14 regardless."

Verstappen fired in a clean 1m36.450s final lap to beat Lando Norris by 0.639 seconds for his fourth win of 2026 - and 75th overall - stretching 37 points clear of Lewis Hamilton for second in the drivers’ championship while keeping Red Bull nine points ahead of McLaren for third in the constructors’ race entering Qatar.

前F1车手乔利恩·帕尔默在F1电视台赛后转播中盛赞维斯塔潘对乔治·拉塞尔的防守战，称这是当前发车格上任何对手都无法匹敌的表现——特别指出在梅赛德斯终于破解了红牛早期能量战术之后，维斯塔潘在比赛中段发起了一连串反击。
这场头排对决在红灯熄灭之前就已背负着沉重的前情。维斯塔潘和拉塞尔在周六晚上抵达时都还带着火气，因为第三次练习赛中14号弯的碰撞引来了赛会的正式警告，拉塞尔痛斥这位荷兰人是个表现得“比别人都更大更好”的家伙。然而在50圈以高达300公里/小时速度进行的激烈较量中，两人在毫厘之间互有攻守，却始终没有发生接触。
在开局阶段，维斯塔潘反复化解了拉塞尔和基米·安东内利的攻势，任由他们在直道上超越自己，随后在17号弯夺回第一。
然而在第25圈安全车重启之后，拉塞尔调整了自己的能量部署——在第28圈和第31圈守住1号弯的领先位置，随后在第37圈将攻击点切换到17号弯。正是在那里，帕尔默看到了非同寻常的一幕。
马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯
“但对我来说，最神奇的是那三四次尝试，看起来乔治已经超过他了，”帕尔默说。“我不认为基米完全弄明白了安全车之后乔治到了哪里。然后他们在安全车下似乎想通了，有几次看起来已经板上钉钉了。
“看起来乔治就要取得领先了。而我必须说，我不认为其他任何车手能像马克斯那样把它夺回来。
“那种切入内线的坚韧，直接把车扔进去——我以为他要锁死轮胎，要打转，冷胎，真的很难，外面又脏又多尘，”帕尔默继续说道。“但他很有侵略性；他做得很精准。他设法在长长的左弯贴住内线，获得良好的牵引力，在3号弯从外侧绕过去。那就是神奇之处。”
“令人屏息的”精准，紧张局势再度点燃
帕尔默强调，虽然能量部署和尾流效应塑造了当晚的比赛，但“最终决定胜负的是赛车技巧”，并指出几乎任何其他车手都会让出弯角，等到下一圈在长直道上再反击。红牛车队领队洛朗·梅基斯在赛道边也表达了同样的看法。“他没有犯任何错误，”梅基斯对F1电视台说。“在这些圈里，他精确到最后一毫米、最后一公里每小时。看着令人屏息。”
在维斯塔潘毫无瑕疵的同时，拉塞尔的攻势在第48圈瓦解，他在攻击安东内利时锁死轮胎，滑入5号弯的护栏，最终追回至第九名。赛后，维斯塔潘在新闻发布会上重提两人的恩怨，称拉塞尔“远低于我的水平”，并把那次迟来的让车称为“因果报应”。
凭借六场比赛中的第四场胜利，维斯塔潘在争夺年度亚军的战斗中领先拉塞尔40分，证明他最有力的回击来自赛道。
detailEn: Jolyon Palmer: No rival could match Max Verstappen's fight against George Russell in Las Vegas
Jolyon Palmer says no other driver could have pulled off Max Verstappen’s Las Vegas moves against George Russell
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.
Even in a Las Vegas Grand Prix packed with 352 overtakes and 35 lead changes, the defining moments of Max Verstappen’s victory came down to raw wheel-to-wheel nerve rather than battery spreadsheets.

Speaking on F1 TV’s post-race broadcast, former Formula 1 driver Jolyon Palmer hailed Verstappen’s defensive fight against George Russell as a display no rival on the current grid could have matched - singling out a string of mid-race counterattacks after Mercedes finally cracked Red Bull’s early energy playbook.

The front-row duel carried heavy baggage before the lights even went out. Verstappen and Russell arrived on Saturday night simmering after a Turn 14 clash in final practice that drew formal warnings from the stewards, with Russell slamming the Dutchman as someone who acts "bigger and better than everyone else". Yet across 50 intense laps at up to 300 km/h, the pair traded blows millimetres apart without making contact.
Through the opening stint, Verstappen repeatedly neutralised Russell and Kimi Antonelli by letting them sweep past down the Strip before reclaiming first at Turn 17.

Following the Lap 25 safety car restart, however, Russell adjusted his deployment - holding the lead into Turn 1 on Laps 28 and 31, and later switching his attack to Turn 17 on Lap 37. That was where Palmer saw something extraordinary.
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, George Russell, Mercedes

"But the magic for me was the three or four attempts where it looked like George had done him," Palmer said. "I don't think Kimi ever quite cottoned on to where George got to after the safety car. Then they seemed to work it out under the safety car, and a few times it looked like it was a done deal.
"It looked like that was going to be George into the race lead. And I have to say, I don't think any other driver would have been able to wrestle it back like Max did.

"The tenacity to go inside, just throw a car in there - I thought he's going to lock up, he's going to spin, cold tyres, it's really tricky, it's dusty and dirty out there," Palmer continued. "But he was aggressive; he was precise with it. He managed to hug the inside through the long left, get some good traction to sweep round the outside at Turn 3. That was the magic."
"Breathtaking" precision amid reignited tension

Palmer stressed that while deployment and slipstreaming shaped the evening, "racecraft won it in the end," noting that almost any other driver would have ceded the corner and waited to fight back on the next lap down the Strip. Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies echoed that verdict trackside. "He didn't put a foot wrong," Mekies told F1 TV. "He was to the last millimetre, to the last kph during these laps. It was breathtaking to watch."

Where Verstappen stayed spotless, Russell’s charge unravelled on Lap 48 when he locked up attacking Antonelli and slid into the Turn 5 barrier, recovering to ninth. Afterwards, Verstappen revived their feud in the press conference, dismissing Russell as "so far below my level" and calling the late off "karma".
With a fourth win in six races, Verstappen stretched 40 points clear of Russell in the fight for championship runner-up, proving his fiercest rebuttal came on the track.
